03
RETRIEVAL-AUGMENTED GENERATION

Your company’s knowledge.
Answers you can trust.

I build RAG systems on your internal knowledge base, tuning every retrieval and generation step using evaluations on your data.

Dense + SparseBM25RerankingEvaluation
  • Vector, lexical (BM25) and hybrid retrieval.
  • Chunking, embedding and reranker selection, with fine-tuning on domain-specific data.
  • Query transformation: multi-query, HyDE, decomposition and query rewriting.
  • Context expansion: parent-child retrieval, neighboring chunks and metadata enrichment.
  • Source citations, groundedness checks and abstention when evidence is insufficient.
  • Document access control, index updates and prompt injection defenses.

03 / HYBRID RETRIEVAL

Meaning + exact matches.

Combine semantic retrieval and BM25, merge results through fusion and promote the most relevant passages with a reranker.

For mixed knowledge bases: prose, names, codes and terminology.
↳ User query
◈ Vector retrievalMeaning and context
⌗ BM25Terms and matches
≋ Fusion + Reranker→Context for the LLM ✓

Also available: multilingual retrieval, OCR for complex documents, tables, knowledge versioning and regression evaluations.

*96% is a potential project target, not a guarantee. Metrics, evaluation data and acceptance criteria are agreed in advance. Results depend on the data, domain and complexity of the questions.
